visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene begins in an outdoor park under bright natural daylight. A young man with short curly hair and glasses, wearing a blue jacket over a white shirt and a backpack, is walking and smiling. A woman with long brown hair, wearing a white t-shirt with a brand logo, approaches him holding a small red box. They interact casually, with the man showing surprise and laughter while the woman points at a mahjong tile. (2) The visual transitions into a rapid montage sequence. The man is seen in various environments: playing mahjong with friends at a square table, standing on a street at night with urban lighting, and holding a white paper certificate during an indoor ceremony. In each shot, his facial expressions are highly animated, characterized by wide smiles and squinted eyes, indicating joy. Yellow and white captions appear frequently at the bottom of the frame. (3) The character is depicted in diverse activities such as running through a grassy field in camouflage gear (paintball), sitting in a dimly lit room pointing at a screen, and interacting with a larger group of people on a stage. The setting shifts from outdoor green spaces to indoor studio environments with professional lighting setups. The man is often the central focus, surrounded by objects like microphones, mahjong tiles, and electronic screens. (4) A close-up shows the man lying on a white couch with a bandage on his wrist, suggesting a minor injury. This is followed by a scene in a photo studio where he is being photographed against a grey background. The lighting is bright and controlled. The final sequence shows the man running down a long, empty bridge toward the camera, with lush green mountains in the distant background under an overcast sky. The video concludes with a black screen featuring large white text.
